text:
Marta: kicking off small schema change on billing.transactions to add `fee_amount_cents` (INT) and a supporting partial index for settled=true. Quiet window 20m. tagging @deploybot to run chunked backfill (500 rows/chunk). pls ack and watch for holdpoints.

deploybot: started job mig-3301234567 on pg-primary-2. chunked backfill chunk_size=500; auto-pause if any lock_wait>5s or replica_lag>40s for >60s. streaming logs: https://deploy/logs/mig-3301234567 :robot_face:

Eli: heads-up  a reconciliation job touches transactions at :05, moved it to :00. i'll throttle background reaper to 0.05 qps for the table.

SRE-Oncall: please list exact pause vs rollback thresholds and a fast abort command. add temp alert for write_p95 and replica_lag.

Marta: Pause (soft hold) triggers: any single lock_wait >5s OR replica_lag >40s sustained >60s OR p95 write latency >220ms for 90s -> deploybot will pause and post a holdpin. Full rollback triggers: migration fails twice OR write error_rate >25% above baseline for 3m OR external payment failures increase >1% for 2m. Escape hatch: `release:abort-mig-3301234567` to pin and stop immediately. Quick rollback commands:
```
# stop migrator
systemctl stop migrator || true
# terminate active ALTERs
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE billing.transactions' AND state <> 'idle';
# revert schema
ALTER TABLE billing.transactions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS fee_amount_cents;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_transactions_fee_settled_partial;
```
Full runbook: /runbooks/migrations/billing_transactions.md.

deploybot: ack. progress: processed_rows=4,200; throughput ~70 rows/s; no pause conditions yet. Posting perf snapshot to infra metrics.

Eli: replica drain finished, lag ~5s. watching tail.

Product: adding short note to release draft: "billing: added fee_amount_cents for clearer fee accounting; migration run during maintenance window; backwards compatible for reads."

SRE-Oncall: temp alerts enabled (write_p95>300ms, replica_lag>60s). will mute noisy alerts.

Marta: thanks. next checkpoint at 15k rows or earlier if a holdpin appears. standing by.
